mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate betamethasone's CNS effects and both drugs can increase blood pressure through sympathomimetic mechanisms; betamethasone may also increase MAOI adverse effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and assess for hypertensive episodes; consider alternative corticosteroid or antidepressant if interaction risk is unacceptable; educate patient on dietary tyramine restrictions.
